charts.title: TOI-5806 b: orbits around TOI-5806
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-5806's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-5806 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lillo-Box et al. 2026 (2026arXiv260719756L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LILLO_BOX_ET_AL_2026): P 3.1856381 d

charts.title: TOI-5806 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-5806 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (56, 82) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 283621618, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 8-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
